poses.caption: Hold the body straight with palms on the wall and elbows extended
Bend elbows to lower the straight body toward the wall, then press away

jobs.detail: WALL PUSH-UP TWO PHASES, strict SIDE three-quarter view, wall LEFT model RIGHT facing left. Full person shoes and hands visible. Vertical plain white wall at image left with faint shadow. Feet hip width entire SOLES INCLUDING HEELS flat on FLOOR, knees straight. LEFT TOP: hands/palms on wall at shoulder height, fingers UP, arms STRAIGHT HORIZONTAL from wall palms to shoulders, elbow angle175-180degrees, elbow NOT bent. Feet positioned so body slightly inclined straight head-hips-heels; do not lean excessively. RIGHT LOWER: SAME feet/hands locations, body straight leans toward wall and BOTH elbows bend90degrees, chest and face close wall but no collision. Clear difference elbow extension vs flexion with whole torso moving together, no hips folding. Same model/wall/camera, no equipment/bench. Primary CHEST only red as ONE soft smoothly blurred diffuse tint on continuous OPAQUE BLACK shirt, no fibers/radial rays/muscle divisions in clothing. All exposed arms/legs fine detailed grayscale anatomical fibers. Full opaque black shirt front sides back and loose knee shorts front sides back seat crotch, no cutaways. No text.
jobs.prompt: Edit original project two-panel wall push-up. Preserve TOP near-straight arms and BOTTOM bent elbows, same palms at shoulder-height wall and straight body line. In BOTH panels rotate feet at ankles so BOTH entire SOLES INCLUDING HEELS plant flat on FLOOR, no tiptoes or lifted heels; move feet a little closer if needed, keep hips/knees straight. RIGHT LOWER ensure forehead/nose do NOT contact wall, leave clear3-5cm gap and neutral neck, adjust torso only enough without losing bent elbows. Smooth diffuse BLURRED RED chest patch on intact opaque BLACK shirt, erase every radial fiber/starburst/muscle division from fabric. Shirt wraps full front sides back; loose black knee shorts front sides back seat crotch. Preserve detailed fine grayscale anatomical fibers on all exposed arms/legs, model/camera, full framing. No text.

poses.caption: Grip the two close-set dumbbell handles and hold a straight high plank
Bend elbows close to the ribs and lower the chest, then press up

jobs.detail: CLOSE-GRIP DUMBBELL PUSH-UP TWO PHASES, whole body front/side three-quarter camera head LEFT feet RIGHT. Exactly TWO small identical gray HEX DUMBBELLS parallel to body length resting stable on FLAT HEX ENDS on FLOOR MAT, handles horizontal at ground level, separated CLOSE about20cm/inside shoulder width under chest. BOTH hands closed NEUTRAL grip around respective dumbbell HANDLE, palms face each other, thumbs/fingers wrap securely, neutral wrists. Dumbbells neither roll nor move between panels, no platform/bench. Feet together toes on floor, knees straight, body straight head-hips-heels. LEFT TOP arms nearly STRAIGHT with dumbbells directly below shoulder/chest, no shoulder shrug. RIGHT LOWER bend both elbows near90degrees keeping elbows tucked CLOSE TO RIBS, chest lowers toward floor between dumbbells, torso/hips/legs stay straight, no deep sag. Whole body and both entire dumbbells visible each panel. Primary TRICEPS only red anatomical fibers on EXPOSED POSTERIOR upper arms; ALL other exposed muscles grayscale fine fibers and NO red on chest/clothes. Full opaque black sleeveless shirt wraps front sides back and loose black knee shorts wrap front sides back seat crotch. No labels/arrows.
